query:
select b.v as booking, s.v as status, eta.v as eta, sum(q.v) as units
from "sku/code" k
join "po_line/sku" pls on pls.v = k.e
join "shipment_line/po_line" slp on slp.v = pls.e
join "shipment_line/quantity" q on q.e = slp.e
join "core/part_of" part on part.e = slp.e
join "shipment/booking_no" b on b.e = part.v
join "shipment/status" s on s.e = b.e
left join "shipment/eta" eta on eta.e = b.e
where k.v = 'AH-KTL-0001-BLK' and s.v in ('departed','arrived')
group by b.v, s.v, eta.v
order by b.v

select b.v as booking, s.v as status, eta.v as eta, q.v as q, slp.e as sl, k.e as ske, k.v
from "sku/code" k
join "po_line/sku" pls on pls.v = k.e
join "shipment_line/po_line" slp on slp.v = pls.e
join "shipment_line/quantity" q on q.e = slp.e
join "core/part_of" part on part.e = slp.e
join "shipment/booking_no" b on b.e = part.v
left join "shipment/status" s on s.e = b.e
left join "shipment/eta" eta on eta.e = b.e
where k.v like 'AH-KTL-0001%'
order by b.v
select * from "core/same_as" limit 20

select 
 (select count(*) from "core/same_as") total,
 (select count(*) from "core/same_as" s join "shopify/customer_id" c on c.e=s.e) cust,
 (select count(*) from "core/same_as" s join "sku/code" c on c.e=s.e) sku,
 (select count(*) from "core/same_as" s join "shipment/booking_no" c on c.e=s.e) ship,
 (select count(*) from "core/same_as" s join "po/number" c on c.e=s.e) po,
 (select count(*) from "core/same_as" s join "supplier/code" c on c.e=s.e) sup,
 (select count(*) from "core/same_as" s join "location/code" c on c.e=s.e) loc,
 (select count(*) from "core/same_as" s join "amazon/asin" c on c.e=s.e) asin

select n.v as po, h.v as etd, h.op, h.tx, at.v as at
from "supplier/code" sc
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.v = sc.e
join "po/number" n on n.e = ps.e
join history."po/etd" h on h.e = ps.e
join "fs/at" at on at.e = h.tx
where sc.v = 'NBBW' and n.v in (select n2.v from "po/number" n2 limit 100000)
order by n.v, h.tx, h.op
limit 1000

with first as (
  select distinct on (h.e) h.e, h.v as first_etd
  from history."po/etd" h
  where h.op = 'assert'
  order by h.e, h.tx
)
select n.v as po, f.first_etd, cur.v as current_etd
from "supplier/code" sc
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.v = sc.e
join "po/number" n on n.e = ps.e
join first f on f.e = ps.e
join "po/etd" cur on cur.e = ps.e
where sc.v = 'NBBW' and cur.v > f.first_etd
order by n.v

select b.v as booking, s.v as status, eta.v as eta
from "shipment/booking_no" b
join "shipment/status" s on s.e = b.e
left join "shipment/eta" eta on eta.e = b.e
where s.v in ('departed','arrived')
order by b.v

select e.e, en.v as entry, f.v as filed, ev.v as ev, d.v as duty, fe.v as fees, cur.v as cur, sup.v as supersedes, sh.v as shipment
from "customs/entry_no" en
join "customs/filed_on" f on f.e = en.e
left join "customs/entered_value" ev on ev.e = en.e
left join "customs/duty" d on d.e = en.e
left join "customs/fees" fe on fe.e = en.e
left join "core/currency" cur on cur.e = en.e
left join "core/supersedes" sup on sup.e = en.e
left join "customs/shipment" sh on sh.e = en.e
join (select 1) e0 on true
join (select en.e from "customs/entry_no" en) e on e.e = en.e
where f.v between '2026-03-15' and '2026-07-15'
order by f.v

select count(*) as n, count(distinct s.v) as targets,
 (select count(*) from "core/supersedes" s2 join "customs/entry_no" c on c.e=s2.e) as customs_new,
 (select count(*) from "core/supersedes" s2 join "customs/entry_no" c on c.e=s2.v) as customs_old
from "core/supersedes" s

select count(*) entries, sum(ev.v) ev, sum(d.v) duty, sum(fe.v) fees
from "customs/entry_no" en
join "customs/filed_on" f on f.e = en.e
left join "customs/entered_value" ev on ev.e = en.e
left join "customs/duty" d on d.e = en.e
left join "customs/fees" fe on fe.e = en.e
where f.v between '2026-04-01' and '2026-06-30'

select sc.v as supplier, r.v as result, count(*) as n
from "qc/report_no" q
join "qc/inspected_on" d on d.e = q.e
join "qc/result" r on r.e = q.e
join "qc/po" qp on qp.e = q.e
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.e = qp.v
join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ps.v
where d.v >= '2026-01-01' and d.v <= '2026-12-31'
group by sc.v, r.v
order by sc.v, r.v

select count(*) total, count(d.v) with_date, count(r.v) with_result, count(qp.v) with_po,
 count(*) filter (where d.v >= '2026-01-01' and d.v <= '2026-12-31') in2026, min(d.v), max(d.v)
from "qc/report_no" q
left join "qc/inspected_on" d on d.e = q.e
left join "qc/result" r on r.e = q.e
left join "qc/po" qp on qp.e = q.e
select f.e, f.a, f.v from facts f where f.e in (select e from "amazon/asin" where v = 'B0BVUGZ3AT') order by f.a

select k.v as sku, sv.v as variant, fn.v as fnsku, ss.v as seller_sku, t.v as tpl, fi.v as factory, sc.v as supplier
from "amazon/asin" a
join "sku/code" k on k.e = a.e
left join "shopify/variant_id" sv on sv.e = a.e
left join "amazon/fnsku" fn on fn.e = a.e
left join "amazon/seller_sku" ss on ss.e = a.e
left join "tpl/item_code" t on t.e = a.e
left join "factory/item_code" fi on fi.e = a.e
left join "sku/supplier" sp on sp.e = a.e
left join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = sp.v
where a.v = 'B0BVUGZ3AT'
select a, v from facts where e = (select e from "po/number" where v = 'PO-2026-0023')
select a, v from facts where e in (select e from "core/part_of" where v = (select e from "po/number" where v = 'PO-2026-0023') limit 1)
select sc.v, sc.e, a, f.v from "supplier/code" sc join facts f on f.e = sc.e order by sc.v, a

select sc.v as supplier, pc.v as po_currency, scur.v as supplier_currency, count(distinct po.e) as pos, count(*) as lines, sum(q.v * p.v) as value
from "po/number" po
join "po/status" st on st.e = po.e
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.e = po.e
join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ps.v
left join "supplier/currency" scur on scur.e = ps.v
left join "core/currency" pc on pc.e = po.e
join "core/part_of" line on line.v = po.e
join "po_line/quantity" q on q.e = line.e
join "po_line/unit_price" p on p.e = line.e
where st.v not in ('shipped','received')
group by sc.v, pc.v, scur.v
order by sc.v
select st.v, count(*) from "po/number" po left join "po/status" st on st.e = po.e group by st.v

select count(*) as lines, count(q.v) as with_q, count(p.v) as with_p
from "po/number" po
join "po/status" st on st.e = po.e
join "core/part_of" line on line.v = po.e
left join "po_line/quantity" q on q.e = line.e
left join "po_line/unit_price" p on p.e = line.e
where st.v not in ('shipped','received')

with recursive
up(start, cur, depth) as (
  select c.e, c.e, 0 from "shopify/customer_id" c where c.v = '8995877069469'
  union all
  select up.start, s.v, up.depth+1 from up join "core/same_as" s on s.e = up.cur
),
root as (select cur as r from up order by depth desc limit 1),
grp(e, depth) as (
  select r, 0 from root
  union all
  select s.e, grp.depth+1 from grp join "core/same_as" s on s.v = grp.e
)
select g.e, g.depth, cid.v as customer_id, (select count(*) from "order/customer" oc where oc.v = g.e) as orders
from grp g left join "shopify/customer_id" cid on cid.e = g.e
order by g.depth, g.e

select oc.e, oc.v as cust, o.v as order_id, oc.tx
from "order/customer" oc left join "shopify/order_id" o on o.e = oc.e
where oc.v in (21553, 21552, 48170) order by oc.v

select h.v as etd, h.op, h.tx, at.v as at, nm.v as actor, ob.v as on_behalf_of
from "po/number" po
join history."po/etd" h on h.e = po.e
left join "fs/at" at on at.e = h.tx
left join "fs/actor" a on a.e = h.tx
left join "fs/name" nm on nm.e = a.v
left join "core/on_behalf_of" ob on ob.e = h.tx
where po.v = 'PO-2026-0023'
order by h.tx

select po.v, e.v as etd, e.tx, at.v as at, nm.v as actor
from "po/number" po
join "po/etd" e on e.e = po.e
join "fs/at" at on at.e = e.tx
join "fs/actor" a on a.e = e.tx
join "fs/name" nm on nm.e = a.v
where po.v = 'PO-2026-0023'
select a, v from facts where e = 154908

select l.v as location, lk.v as kind, q.v as quantity, ca.v as counted_at, ip.v as position
from "sku/code" k
join "inventory/sku" isk on isk.v = k.e
join "inventory/location" il on il.e = isk.e
join "location/code" l on l.e = il.v
join "location/kind" lk on lk.e = il.v
left join "inventory/quantity" q on q.e = isk.e
left join "inventory/counted_at" ca on ca.e = isk.e
left join "inventory/position" ip on ip.e = isk.e
where k.v = 'AH-TWL-0007-NAT'
order by lk.v, l.v

with recursive
up(cur, depth) as (
  select c.e, 0 from "shopify/customer_id" c where c.v = '8995877069469'
  union all
  select s.v, up.depth+1 from up join "core/same_as" s on s.e = up.cur
),
root as (select cur as r from up order by depth desc limit 1),
grp(e) as (
  select r from root
  union all
  select s.e from grp join "core/same_as" s on s.v = grp.e
)
select (select count(*) from grp) as accounts,
       (select count(*) from "order/customer" oc join grp on grp.e = oc.v) as orders

select l.v as location_code, lk.v as kind, q.v as quantity
from "sku/code" k
join "inventory/sku" isk on isk.v = k.e
join "inventory/location" il on il.e = isk.e
join "location/code" l on l.e = il.v
join "location/kind" lk on lk.e = il.v
join "inventory/quantity" q on q.e = isk.e
where k.v = 'AH-TWL-0007-NAT' and lk.v in ('factory','in_transit')
order by l.v
